# Davit Febuan

> Operations leader in Jakarta, Indonesia. E-Channel Services Head at Bank Mega, responsible for the ATM, EDC, QRIS and payment gateway services: installation, monitoring, maintenance, resupply and retrieval, vendor agreements and the maintenance budget. Availability held above 99.8% every month. In payments and supply chain operations since 2006.

- [Profil Bahasa Indonesia](https://davitfebuan.com/id/): versi Bahasa Indonesia

## Career
- 2024 – present: E-Channel Services Head, Bank Mega. Strategy and operations for ATM, EDC, QRIS and payment gateway services; vendor agreements, maintenance OPEX, policies and the team.
- 2020 – 2024: Head of Operations, CT Corp Digital. Set up operations for new digital businesses across the CT Corp ecosystem (retail and grocery delivery, a digital bank, a beauty platform): order-to-delivery flow, reverse logistics, CRM and customer service, then handed them over.
- 2019 – 2020: Distribution Manager, Bhinneka.com. Sourcing, warehousing and delivery for B2G, B2B and e-commerce; routing for 200+ deliveries a day; Power BI KPI dashboards.
- 2016 – 2019: Logistics Manager, PT Graha Sumber Prima Elektronik. Manufacturing operations, sourcing and logistics on a $3M+ annual budget; $100K first-year savings and 5%+ annual cost reduction after.
- 2013 – 2016: PPIC Supervisor, PT Graha Sumber Prima Elektronik. S&OP and demand planning; inventory within 1% of production schedules.
- 2011 – 2013: Logistics Supervisor, PT Graha Sumber Prima Elektronik. Nationwide delivery and installation to tower sites, 99% on time.
- 2007 – 2011: Merchant Operations, Bank Mega. EDC operations end to end; 800 terminals rolled out in year one; Visa and Mastercard UAT certification.
- 2006 – 2007: IT Staff, UD. Buana. Hardware, software and networks across 4 warehouses and 3 shops.
